text:
maria: Heads-up: inventory probe found ~120 nodes in us-west with mismatched firewall tags. Some are hitting the wrong privnet egress.
aj: Ugh, that explains the spike in KMS latencies we've been seeing. Node joins started failing earlier this morning.
sanjay: Any pattern? instance type / subnet / autoscaler group?
maria: Mostly gpu-warm pools and a few spare on-demand nodes. Tags show `env:prod` but missing `keystore:allowed` so traffic dropped to a stricter route.
kevin: So keystore requests were being routed through the long-path NAT instead of the keystore proxy cluster?
aj: Yep. We saw retry storms to KMS endpoint -> increased conntrack -> kubelet timeouts -> GPU onboarding stalls.
opsbot: Alert: keystore-decrypt-errors > 5% in us-west (rolling 15m). CI jobs impacted: 12 failing.
maria: Started a quick remedial rollout: added `keystore:allowed` to the warm-pool SGs in us-west-canary. Monitoring.
sanjay: Can we pin a fallback for node-join that uses local keystore cache if KMS calls slow? That would reduce cascading failures.
kevin: Long term yes, but cache expiry/consistency is tricky for private keystore keys.
aj: For now we need firewall tag drift root cause. Anything changed in the recent infra deploys?
maria: Deploy-bot started a tagging migration last night to enforce `team:infra` on all gpu subnets. Looks like a regex mismatch skipped some ASG names.
deploy-bot: CI/CD: tag-migration v2 applied to 6 ASGs, 2 failed validation and were skipped (gpu-warmpool-3, gpu-warmpool-7).
kevin: That matches the list. Those ASGs are still on old tag set.
aj: Quick mitigation plan: 1) patch ASG tags for the two groups (manual), 2) add temporary keystore allowlist for their subnets, 3) throttle audit log verbosity to avoid natgw saturation.
sanjay: Step 3 is important — audit logs have been blowing up and filling the natgw bandwidth. We should avoid flipping retention yet, just sample at 10%.
maria: Agreed. I'll apply manual tags, add subnet allowlist in firewall policy (short TTL), and flip audit sampling to 10% for us-west for 30m.
kevin: Cost note: reducing audit sampling will cut S3/egress egress by ~25% this hour. But we need to document this for compliance.
aj: Flagging security: we'll need post-mortem and an attestation for the temporary allowlist + sampling reduction. Eng-security looped in.
maria: Patch going out in 2 mins. `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-warmpool-3 --tags Key=keystore,Value=allowed,PropagateAtLaunch=true`
kevin: Will watch metrics. Also throttle node join concurrency to avoid spike during catch-up: set `MAX_PARALLEL=6` on warm-pool controller.
opsbot: Change approved and applied: audit-sampler=10% (us-west), firewall-temporary-rule=SUBNET-allow-keystore-uswest, max_parallel=6.
aj: Seeing immediate drop in KMS 5xxs. Node join queue length decreasing.
sanjay: Can we add a health-check that asserts `keystore:allowed` tag before scaling events? Prevents future drift.
maria: Yep, adding to pre-hook policy. Also opening a ticket to fix the regex in tag-migration job.
kevin: Reminder: for the postmortem include cost delta from audit-sampling and S3 egress; product compliance will want exact numbers.
maria: Will compile. Initial numbers: estimated 4TB egress avoided by sampling over 1 hour (~$320). Will refine.
aj: Closing loop: firewall rule will be removed after 2 hours or when keystore 5xx < 0.5% for 15m.
sanjay: Thanks everyone. Keep an eye on ap-south, just in case the migration job hit other regions.
opsbot: Monitoring configured for us-west; will add ap-south alert if similar drift detected.
kevin: Good job catching this quickly. Postmortem runbook please.
maria: Filing postmortem draft now -> will ping eng-security for attestation.
